priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: CPR / life support not provided properly
inspections.detail: Provide basic life support, including CPR, prior to the arrival of emergency medical personnel , subject to physician orders and the resident’s advance directives.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Medicare/Medicaid coverage notice not given
inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Help with daily activities not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.

inspections.title: Significant medication error
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

inspections.title: Menus not meeting nutrition needs
inspections.detail: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive.

inspections.title: Services not up to professional standards
inspections.detail: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.

inspections.title: Resident choices not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Unnecessary medications given
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: Non-profit nursing home in Grand Island with 36 certified beds. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab. Part of a continuing care retirement community, so residents can move between levels of care on one campus.
